title: Lonnie Zamora sighting near nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Well, Lonnie Zamora happened a couple miles from the

plain: The 1964 sighting by a police officer named Lonnie Zamora in Socorro, New Mexico, took place only a couple of miles from nuclear sites, according to Michels. He makes the point himself, without naming a source, while debating a skeptic, as part of a pattern he sees: UFO reports that cluster around nuclear facilities.
